top_signals.title: Japan Student-Loan, Housing Finance Bonds Sold at Record Coupons
top_signals.summary: Japan Student Services Organization and Japan Housing Finance Agency both priced their bonds at record high coupons as rising rates increasingly show up in borrowing costs for students and homeowners.
